movementImplementation.rendering: Interpolated 3D scene with independent turret facing
movementImplementation.pathPlanning: Radius-aware cached A*, shared group corridors, deterministic four-request fallback queue
movementImplementation.localMovement: Per-unit catalog profiles, compact destination reservations, predictive avoidance, sideways idle yielding, anchored Hold/Siege and collision settling

knownDifferences: Custom 3D models and terrain rather than the original game assets
Custom steering and pathfinding rather than the proprietary SC2 solver; exact feel is not established
Terran subset only; unsupported reference buttons are dimmed and explain their status
No multiplayer, air combat, ramps, full tech tree, campaigns, or other races
Factory Tank position follows the current editor data; older extracted data uses a different position
Movement and weapon numbers imported for the six implemented units; other stats and all current-patch values are not fully audited
Navigation, arrival reservations, steering, turn integration, targeting priorities, pursuit and attack arcs remain custom policies; not verified identical to SC2
Weapon randomness, missile acceleration and exact effect conditions are omitted; shots quantize to 60 Hz
Tank morph times use an older catalog snapshot; full current-patch validation is incomplete
Concussive Shells, Reaper grenade and cliff jumping remain absent

verification.controls: Selection modifiers, Standard hotkeys, control-group stealing, subgroups, order queues, minimap commands, camera locations, idle workers
verification.movement: 24 units route around rock and settle; held units remain anchored; rapid reversal responds; 120-unit repeated-command stress exercise
verification.gameplay: Gathering, construction queue back to mining, producer rally, Tech Lab requirement, Stim research gate, siege mode, resource-limited AI opening
verification.unitMechanics: 41 browser behavior regressions including canceled shots, cooldowns, target persistence, projectile flight, per-hit armor, flame geometry, friendly splash and regeneration

combatImplementation.targeting: Persistent targets, explicit overrides, range-limited acquisition, Move suppression, both-team vision
combatImplementation.weapons: Cancelable windup/recovery, preserved cooldowns, per-hit armor, attribute bonuses, missile travel, flame line, friendly siege splash, minimum range, Reaper burst and regen
